rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=7, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.01, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-5 img_kernel=7/lr5e-3/ep10 hr=0.2515). (1) PRIOR: img_kernel 5->7 gave +0.005 (new best 0.2515); depth saturated at 7 BFs; epochs flat. All iters used Wagner default lr=5e-3. (2) Failure mode: with only ~24 params and 10 epochs, lr=5e-3 may leave the BF sigmas short of their optimum (under-stepped). (3) ONE KNOB: lr 5e-3 -> 1e-2 (img_kernel=7/img_n_bf=7/ep10 held; grad_clip=1.0 guards instability). (4) HYPOTHESIS: doubling lr reaches a lower L2 minimum within 10 epochs and lifts hr above 0.2515 toward ~0.26; if hr DROPS (too aggressive), 5e-3 is the lr optimum and iter-7 pivots to img_sr (range bandwidth) or lambda_neg. (5) BUDGET: same ep10 -> ~120s, inside 20 min. (6) Loop continues. Artifacts saved.
